$comment: ONE BNPL AICS — CANONICAL FEATURE MANIFEST.
This file is the single source of truth for the model input vector. It is read by:
2. apps/ml/app/manifest.py                       -> Pydantic model + numpy column order
Because all three read the SAME ordered array, the column order at fit time is
provably the column order at predict time. Do not reorder or remove entries; append
new features at the end and bump `version` (minor for additive, major for breaking).
1 -> increasing this feature must never DECREASE predicted default risk
-1 -> increasing this feature must never INCREASE predicted default risk
FAIR LENDING (§10.2): gender, age/DOB, nationality, ethnicity, caste, religion and
marital status are deliberately ABSENT. They are stored on the Applicant record for
disparate-impact testing only and must never appear in this manifest.
scale: P(default) — higher output means higher risk

features.name: avg_balance_6m
features.label: Average daily balance (6 months)
features.adverseAction: Your average account balance over the last 6 months is below the level we look for

features.name: min_monthly_balance_6m
features.label: Lowest month-end balance (6 months)
features.adverseAction: Your account dropped to a low balance during the statement period

features.name: salary_consistency_months
features.label: Months with a verified salary credit
features.adverseAction: We could not verify a regular monthly salary credit across the full statement period

features.name: avg_monthly_income
features.label: Average verified monthly income
features.adverseAction: Your verified monthly income is below the level required for the amount requested

features.name: income_stability_cv
features.label: Income volatility (coefficient of variation)
features.adverseAction: Your monthly income varies more than we can comfortably underwrite

features.name: dsr
features.label: Debt service ratio
features.adverseAction: Your existing loan and card obligations take up too large a share of your income

features.name: savings_rate
features.label: Average monthly savings rate
features.adverseAction: Very little of your monthly income remains after outgoings

features.name: cash_buffer_months
features.label: Cash buffer (months of spend covered)
features.adverseAction: Your balance would cover only a short period of normal spending

features.name: bounce_count_6m
features.label: Bounced cheques / NSF events
features.adverseAction: Your statement shows returned or dishonoured payments

features.name: overdraft_days_6m
features.label: Days in overdraft
features.adverseAction: Your account spent time in overdraft during the statement period

features.name: late_payment_count_6m
features.label: Late EMI / card / utility payments
features.adverseAction: Some of your recurring obligations were paid later than scheduled

features.name: employer_tier_score
features.label: Employer quality tier
features.adverseAction: Your current employer category carries a higher risk weighting in our model

features.name: total_experience_years
features.label: Total years of work experience
features.adverseAction: Your recorded work history is shorter than we typically look for

features.name: career_progression_slope
features.label: Career progression trend
features.adverseAction: Your role seniority has not progressed over the period covered by your CV

features.name: salary_growth_rate
features.label: Year-on-year salary growth
features.adverseAction: Your salary has grown more slowly than the benchmark for your experience level

features.name: education_level_score
features.label: Education quality score
features.adverseAction: Your recorded education level contributes less to the score than higher qualifications would

features.name: certification_score
features.label: Professional certifications score
features.adverseAction: Few professional certifications were found on your CV

features.name: expected_to_past_salary_ratio
features.label: Expected salary vs last salary
features.adverseAction: Your stated salary expectation is far above your last verified salary

features.name: countries_traveled_count
features.label: Countries travelled
features.adverseAction: Limited international travel history was recorded

features.name: premium_visa_count
features.label: Premium visas held (Schengen / US / UK)
features.adverseAction: No high-scrutiny visa history was found, which would otherwise support the score

features.name: reference_tier_score
features.label: Reference quality score
features.adverseAction: The professional references provided are below the seniority level that strengthens an application

features.name: institutional_tier_score
features.label: Institutional network tier
features.adverseAction: The institutions in your history carry a lower prestige weighting in our model

features.name: residence_stability_years
features.label: Years at current address
features.adverseAction: You have lived at your current address for a relatively short time

features.name: kyc_completeness_pct
features.label: KYC document completeness
features.adverseAction: Some identity documents were missing or could not be verified

features.name: awards_score
features.label: Awards and recognition score
features.adverseAction: No industry awards or recognitions were recorded

features.name: avg_employer_tenure_years
features.label: Average tenure per employer
features.adverseAction: Your average time with each employer is shorter than we look for

features.name: job_changes_count
features.label: Number of job changes
features.adverseAction: Your CV shows frequent changes of employer

features.name: income_stream_count
features.label: Independent income streams
features.adverseAction: Your income comes from a single source, which offers less protection if it stops

features.name: emi_payment_punctuality
features.label: EMI payment punctuality
features.adverseAction: Not all of your existing instalments were paid on schedule

features.name: discretionary_spend_ratio

features.name: atm_withdrawal_ratio

features.name: savings_months_count
features.label: Months with net positive savings

features.name: countries_worked_count
features.label: Countries worked in
features.adverseAction: Your career has been in a single country, which scores lower on our mobility measure

features.name: insurance_premium_active
features.label: Active insurance premium detected
features.adverseAction: No regular insurance premium payment was detected, which would otherwise signal financial planning

features.name: credit_card_utilization_proxy
features.label: Credit card utilisation (proxy)
features.adverseAction: Your card repayments suggest a high level of revolving credit use

features.name: requested_amount_to_income_ratio
features.label: Requested amount vs annual income
features.adverseAction: The amount requested is large relative to your verified income

features.name: tenure_months
features.label: Requested repayment tenure
features.adverseAction: The repayment tenure requested affects the risk profile of this application

features.name: statement_months_available
features.label: Months of bank statement supplied
features.adverseAction: You supplied fewer months of bank statement than the 6 months our assessment requires
